summary: Contemporary R&B (trap-soul, alt R&B): 70-95 BPM, soft 808 drums with rims, shakers and swing, a deep sub bass on the roots, lush 7th and 9th chords held on Rhodes or pads, space left for the voice; knowledge/style/rnb.json is its template
body: Tempo 70-95 BPM (also written at 130-160 felt half-time, the trap way); slow enough to leave room for vocal runs and ad-libs.

Drums: TR-808 sounds: a round short-tailed kick, a soft snare or clap on 2 and 4 (3 in half-time), rimshots, a maraca or shaker on the off-beats, hats with swing (60-70%) and the odd triplet or roll; ghost notes, laid back.
Bass: a deep sub (an 808 or sine-ish synth) on the chord roots, tuned to the key, long notes with glides; a short punchy kick so the two don't fight.
Harmony: extended chords, never bare triads: maj7, m7, 9ths, sus2/sus4 for a floating feel; descending IVmaj7-iii7-ii7-Imaj7, minor i9-iv9-VImaj7; held on a Rhodes/Wurli, soft pads or strings.
Lead: the voice; as an instrument, a clean electric guitar or soft keys answering it, sparse.
Texture/master: warm and smooth, deep lows and airy highs with scooped mids, gentle glue; nothing harsh.
Sources (2026-11-26): Attack Magazine 'Beat Dissected: 808 R&B' and 'Dark R&B'; Native Instruments 'R&B chord progressions'; UJAM 'The Ultimate Guide to R&B'; Output 'R&B Type Beat Guide'.
Apply: pattern/gmd-hiphop-beat-1 on the drums, then pattern/prog-r-and-b-common-4 on the keys four bars later. For a whole style change the Team Lead's restyle uses knowledge/style/rnb.json instead.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
